senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A usurer, a money lender.
E.
द्वि two, गुण number, affix ठक्; who requires cent. per cent.

n. (-ण्यं)
1 Duality.
2 The possession of two out of the three qualities.
3 Doubling.
E.
द्विगुण, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Twice born.
E.
द्विजात, and अण् aff.

n. (-तं)
1 Duplication, doubling or being doubled.
2 Duality, in philosophy, the assertion of two principles, as the distinctness of life and soul, spirit and matter, god and the universe.
E.
द्वि two, तल् affix, द्वित double, two-fold, abstract affix अण्.

m. (-दी)
A philosopher who asserts two principles.
E.
द्वैत, and वादिन् who asserts.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Second.
E.
द्वितीय second, pleonastick affix अण्, and ईकक् added.

mfn. (-धः-धी-धं)
Two-fold, of two sorts.
n. (-धं)
1 A double resource, a stratagem, a secondary arrangement or array, a reserve.
2 Contest, dispute, difference.
3 A two-fold form or state.
E.
द्वैधम्, and ड added.

ind.
In two ways.
E.
द्वि, and धमुञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Making two, separating, disuniting.
E.
द्वैध, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Separated.
2 Made into two, sundered.
E.
द्वैध, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

m. (-वः)
1 Sowing dissension, causing the separation of allies.
2 Dividing into two.
3 The nature or property of being two or distinct.
E.
द्वैध, and भाव property, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Being two, being separated or disunited.
E.
द्वैध, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
1 Made of a tiger's skin.
2 Island, islander.
m. (-पः)
A car covered or hung with a tiger's skin.
E.
द्वीप a tiger's skin, and अञ् aff.

m. (-नः)
A name of VYĀSA, the author or compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas.
E.
द्वीप an island, फक् affix; the island-born, the place of his nativity being a small island in the Ganges.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Of or belonging to an island.
E.
द्वीप an island, यञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Having two mothers, or the natural mother and a step-mother.
m. (-रः)
1 A name of GAṆEŚA.
2 An epithet of JARĀSANDHA: see जरासन्ध.
E.
द्वि two, मातृ a mother, अण् affix, उ substituted for the penultimate: see द्विमातृज.

mfn. (-त्रिः-त्री-त्ति)
Born of two friends, the children, &c.
E.
द्वि, and मित्र a friend, इञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or belonging to two days.
E.
द्व्यहन्, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-थः)
Single combat in chariots.
E.
द्विरथ two cars, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or belonging to a period of two nights.
E.
द्विरात्र, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
After two years, of or belonging to two years to come.
E.
द्वि, वर्ष a year, ठञ् aff.

n. (-ध्यः)
The state of being two-fold.
E.
द्विविध, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
The age of two years.
E.
द्विहायन, and अण् aff.
